lines.en: : Surprise! It’s me again. Not whoever that cutie walking down the hall just now was.
lines.zh: 惊喜！又是我。不是刚刚走过去的那位小可爱。
想我了吗？
我-

lines.en: : Just kidding. I obviously know you miss me. It’s written all over your face — which looks pretty great for how old you’ve gotten in my...{i}prolonged absence.{/i}
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。我当然知道你想我。全写在你的脸上了——考虑到我{i}长期缺席{/i}的这些年里你都老成这样了，气色还真不错。

lines.en: : Do you like my costume? I was going for “ghost” but I couldn’t find a sheet that was white enough.
lines.zh: 你喜欢我的装扮吗？我本来想扮「幽灵」，可找不到足够白的床单。

lines.en: : Thankfully, this pretty dress was on sale at the thrift store around the block from my house in purgatory.
lines.zh: 幸好这条漂亮的裙子在炼狱里我家附近那家二手店打折。

lines.en: : Or was it Heaven? I can’t really remember which one is which anymore. They all start blurring together after you get hit by a car.
lines.zh: 还是说那是天堂？我实在记不清哪个是哪个了。被车撞过之后，它们全都糊成一团了。

lines.en: : Oh, and I added this little boob window myself. All these years later and I’m still handy with a pair of scissors. Who would have known?
lines.zh: 哦，对了，这个小小的露胸窗是我自己加的。这么多年过去，我拿剪刀的手艺还没丢。谁能想到呢？
怎么样？
你觉得呢？

lines.en: : Do you think this is funny?
lines.zh: 你觉得这很好笑吗？
好笑？你什么意思？

lines.en: : Showing up like this? Putting on a {i}costume{/i} like you’re actually here with the rest of the girls? Does this make you happy?
lines.zh: 这样出现？穿着{i}变装{/i}，装得好像真跟其他女孩们一起在这儿似的？这让你开心吗？

lines.en: : Hey don’t be mad at {i}me.{/i} It’s not like I {i}wanted{/i} to die. Well, no more than anyone else I mean.
lines.zh: 嘿，别冲{i}我{/i}发火。又不是我{i}想{/i}死的。好吧，至少不比别人更想。

lines.en: : But, if it were up to me, we’d be on a beach in Cancun right now. Are you really going to throw a temper tantrum just because I look a little different than you’re accustomed to?
lines.zh: 不过，要是由我说了算，我们现在就在坎昆的海滩上了。就因为我看起来跟你习惯的不太一样，你真打算耍脾气？

lines.en: : Because, if that’s the case, imagine how {i}I{/i} feel. The Aki-kun {i}I{/i} knew best still had a tiny little baby dick. And the one you’ve got now would probably tear straight through my cervix.
lines.zh: 因为要是这样的话，想想{i}我{/i}是什么感受。我认识的那个 Aki-kun 还长着一根小小的娃娃鸡巴。而你现在这根，大概会直接捅穿我的子宫颈。
出去。

lines.en: : And go where? The purgatorial-slash-heavenly thrift shop is closed on holidays and Ami is playing with her friends right now. Are you saying you don’t want to spend time with me?
lines.zh: 去哪儿？炼狱兼天堂的二手店节假日不开门，Ami 现在正跟朋友们玩呢。你是说你不想跟我待着？

lines.en: : I’m saying you should leave. You’re good at that, aren’t you?
lines.zh: 我是说你该走了。你不是很擅长这个吗？

lines.en: : Oh, come on. Give me a break, Akira. I’m just trying to make the best of a shitty situation and you’re making it seem like some kind of {i}haunting.{/i}
lines.zh: 哦，得了吧。别这样，Akira。我只是想把这操蛋的处境变得好一点，你却搞得像是什么{i}闹鬼{/i}。
因为它就是！

lines.en: : You keep showing up! You’re supposed to be gone!
lines.zh: 你不停地出现！你本该已经消失了！

lines.en: : Now I’m just confused. You want me to leave, but you’re sad that I’m gone?
lines.zh: 现在轮到我糊涂了。你想让我走，可你又为我走了而难过？

lines.en: : I’m not sad! I’m fine! I’ve been great since you’ve left!
lines.zh: 我没有难过！我很好！你走了以后我一直都很好！

lines.en: : I’ll say. You’ve got quite the little harem now, don’t you?
lines.zh: 我看得出来。你现在有个不小的后宫了嘛。

lines.en: : Though, it’s not without its errors.
lines.zh: 不过，也不是没有纰漏。

lines.en: : All things considered, I think you’ve been taking things a little too slow.
lines.zh: 综合来看，我觉得你把事情推进得太慢了。

lines.en: : Just imagine how many boys I’d have had by now if our roles were reversed and {i}you{/i} were the one who died in an accident.
lines.zh: 想想看，要是我们的角色对调，{i}你{/i}才是那个在事故里死掉的人，我现在该有多少个男孩了。

lines.en: : Why, I’d barely get any sleep.
lines.zh: 哎呀，我大概连觉都睡不了。

lines.en: : Sometimes I wish that’s what would have happened.
lines.zh: 有时候我真希望发生的是那样。

lines.en: : You wish that I’d get fucked by a group of twenty teenage boys? You should know {i}very well{/i} just how much stamina they have at that age, Aki-kun.
lines.zh: 你希望我被二十个十几岁的男孩轮着操？Aki-kun，你该{i}很清楚{/i}那个年纪的人有多能折腾。
我希望死的是我。

lines.en: : That got fucked by a group of twenty teenage boys?
lines.zh: 被二十个十几岁的男孩轮着操？
是死掉。

lines.en: : And you don’t think that’s sad?
lines.zh: 你不觉得那很可悲吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know what it is. But I don’t know how I’m ever supposed to get better if you keep doing this.
lines.zh: 我不知道那是什么。但我不知道，如果你一直这样，我要怎么才能好起来。

lines.en: : Who says you need to get better? As far as I’m concerned, you’re as close to perfect as they come.
lines.zh: 谁说你需要好起来？在我看来，你已经接近完美了。

lines.en: : That’s why you were always my favorite. And that’s why I’m “haunting” you and no one else.
lines.zh: 所以你一直是我最喜欢的。所以我「缠着」的是你，不是别人。

lines.en: : Who’s that? She looks young. Even for {i}your{/i} tastes.
lines.zh: 那是谁？她看着好小。就算以{i}你{/i}的口味来说。
……她叫 Sana。
屁股挺可爱。
你知道她醒着吧？
什么？

lines.en: : I mean she’s only pretending to be asleep right now. Probably because she’s getting off on the fact that she’s vulnerable and alone with her handsome teacher.
lines.zh: 我是说她现在只是在装睡。大概是因为她正为「自己脆弱无助、还跟帅气的老师独处」这件事而兴奋。
你硬了吗？
能让我看看吗？

lines.en: : Just tell me what you want so you can go back to leaving me alone until it’s fun for you to show up and torment me again.
lines.zh: 直接说你想要什么吧，说完你就能继续丢下我一个人，等到下次你觉得来折磨我很有趣时再出现。

lines.en: : I want to see your boner, Aki-kun. I literally just told you that. Come show Mommy how much you’ve grown.
lines.zh: 我想看你硬起来的鸡巴，Aki-kun。我刚刚才说过啊。来，让妈妈看看你长大了多少。
你{i}来{/i}这儿不是为这个，Sekai。

lines.en: : There’s more to it than that.
lines.zh: 不止这个。

lines.en: : Because there’s {i}always{/i} more to it than that.
lines.zh: 因为{i}永远{/i}都不止这个。

lines.en: : Even before you were gone, I could never figure out what you were really after.
lines.zh: 早在你离开之前，我就从没搞懂你到底想要什么。

lines.en: : It was always a game to you. And I was nothing more than another piece in it, just like everyone else.
lines.zh: 对你来说那永远是场游戏。而我不过是其中一枚棋子，跟其他人一样。

lines.en: : Is that how you really feel?
lines.zh: 你真的是这么想的吗？

lines.en: : Yes. But I’m not about to spend what little time we have together reminding you for the ten millionth time that I {i}do{/i} love you. I always did and I always will.
lines.zh: 是的。但我可不打算把我们仅有的这点时间，花在第一千万次提醒你——我{i}确实{/i}爱你上。我一直都爱，而且永远都会。

lines.en: : If you don’t want to accept that, that’s your problem. Not mine.
lines.zh: 如果你不肯接受，那是你的问题。不是我的。

lines.en: : I’m {i}well aware{/i} that it’s my problem. You’re just not helping and I already have enough going on today {i}without{/i} you being involved.
lines.zh: 我{i}很清楚{/i}那是我的问题。你只是在帮倒忙，而且我今天{i}没有{/i}你掺和就已经够乱的了。

lines.en: : I know. I’ve been watching. I’m {i}always{/i} watching. That’s how the whole “being dead” thing works.
lines.zh: 我知道。我一直在看着。我{i}一直{/i}在看着。「死了」就是这么回事。

lines.en: : But that’s exactly what I want to talk to you about, Aki-kun. It would be so easy to make all of that go away. And yet, here you are, completely worthless and flopping around like a fish out of water.
lines.zh: 但这正是我想跟你谈的，Aki-kun。要让那一切消失简直易如反掌。可你看看你，彻底没用，像条离了水的鱼一样在地上扑腾。

lines.en: : You realize summer’s almost over, don’t you? And that the next season is right around the corner?
lines.zh: 你知道夏天快结束了吧？下一个季节就在拐角处了？

lines.en: : Did you remember to do your homework?
lines.zh: 你记得做作业了吗？

lines.en: : What homework? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: 什么作业？你在说什么？

lines.en: : You know exactly what I’m talking about. You were even reminded a couple hours ago.
lines.zh: 你很清楚我在说什么。几个小时前还有人提醒过你。

lines.en: : You’re supposed to take something that doesn’t belong to you or bad things are going to happen. That’s what all those voices told you, right?
lines.zh: 你应该拿走一件不属于你的东西，否则就会有坏事发生。那些声音都是这么告诉你的，对吧？
那些不是真的。

lines.en: : What {i}is{/i} real then? Because, to me, it seems like you’ve been grappling with that exact question from the moment you woke up. And your answer keeps changing.
lines.zh: 那什么{i}才{/i}是真的？因为在我看来，从你醒过来的那一刻起，你就一直在跟这个问题搏斗。而你的答案一直在变。

lines.en: : So tell me what it will take for you to change your answer {i}this{/i} time. Let your teacher {i}help{/i} you with your homework if you can’t finish it yourself.
lines.zh: 所以告诉我，{i}这次{/i}要怎样才能让你改变答案。要是你自己做不完作业，就让你的老师{i}帮{/i}你做完吧。

lines.en: : Why? What do you even have to gain from this?
lines.zh: 为什么？你到底能从这里面得到什么？

lines.en: : Nothing. I’m destined to swim forever through the rivers of the dead and, so long as you exist, there will always be an inlet leading me right back into you.
lines.zh: 什么也得不到。我注定要在冥河里永远游下去，而只要你还存在，就总有一条水道能把我引回你身边。

lines.en: : I want to help because I care.
lines.zh: 我想帮忙是因为我在乎。

lines.en: : Do you really think I’d leave someone like {i}you{/i} alone on purpose? You were totally helpless without me. And you’d be totally helpless {i}now{/i} if Ami hadn’t taken up the mantle of Aki-kun’s red-headed crutch.
lines.zh: 你真以为我会故意丢下{i}你{/i}这样的人不管？没有我你完全束手无策。而{i}现在{/i}要不是 Ami 接过了「Aki-kun 的红发拐杖」这副担子，你也一样束手无策。
Ami 一点也不像你。

lines.en: : Jeez. I know lying to yourself is kind of your whole thing, but the fact that you were able to say that one without even batting an eye is really impressive.
lines.zh: 天哪。我知道自欺欺人算是你的专长，可你连眼睛都不眨一下就能说出这句话，真是令人叹服。
你-

lines.en: : Listen. Beating around the bush isn’t going to have any sort of impact on {i}me,{/i} but if you don’t take what I’m about to say seriously, you could lose {i}everything.{/i} And I mean {i}everything.{/i}
lines.zh: 听着。拐弯抹角对{i}我{/i}起不到任何作用，但如果你不把我要说的话当回事，你可能会失去{i}一切{/i}。我是说{i}一切{/i}。
{i}屈服{/i}于那些声音。那些{i}冲动{/i}。

lines.en: : Stop trying to be a big, strong boy and accept that some people are just weaker than others. You’re one of those people, Aki-kun. You’re not {i}meant{/i} to be brave.
lines.zh: 别再硬撑着当个高大强壮的男孩子了，接受吧——有些人就是比别人弱。你就是那种人，Aki-kun。你{i}天生{/i}就不是当勇士的料。

lines.en: : You don’t have what it takes to grab life by the balls and yank them off. All {i}you{/i} can do is submit.
lines.zh: 你没有那种抓住生活的卵蛋、一把扯下来的本事。{i}你{/i}唯一能做的，就是屈服。

lines.en: : And, as your stand-in mother figure slash previously-living human onahole, I feel as if it is my duty to inform you that the path you’ve “chosen” is wrong.
lines.zh: 而作为你的代理母亲兼曾经活过的人形飞机杯，我觉得我有责任告诉你：你「选」的那条路是错的。

lines.en: : You {i}need{/i} to do this. And you need to do it {i}quickly{/i} because your time is almost up.
lines.zh: 你{i}必须{/i}做这件事。而且必须{i}尽快{/i}，因为你的时间快到了。

lines.en: : {b}Take something that doesn’t belong to you.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}拿走一件不属于你的东西。{/b}
我做不到……

lines.en: : Sure you can. You already did it once.
lines.zh: 你当然做得到。你不是已经做过一次了吗。
我-
等等……等等，等等，等等！

lines.en: : Don’t tell me you actually tricked yourself into believing that was all just in your head?!
lines.zh: 你该不会真的骗自己相信那一切都是你的幻觉吧？！

lines.en: : Hahaha! Hahahahahahah! Aaahhhahahahah! Oh God! My sides! My sides! I’m gonna die!
lines.zh: 哈哈哈哈！哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！啊哈哈哈哈哈！哦天哪！我的肚子！我的肚子！我要笑死了！
哦。等等。我已经死了。

lines.en: : That was so funny I nearly forgot.
lines.zh: 太好笑了，我差点忘了。
那没发生过……她……我……

lines.en: : God, can you seriously just get over that already? It’s really not that big of a deal. Plus, if you want to get {i}super{/i} technical, you’ve been raping basically everyone and everything this whole time, Aki-kun.
lines.zh: 天啊，你能不能别再纠结那件事了？真没什么大不了的。再说了，要是真要{i}较真{/i}的话，你这段时间基本上把所有人、所有东西都给强奸了一遍，Aki-kun。

lines.en: : Girls at this age are so horny and confused that they can’t even figure out what they’re really after until their hormones have already started to die down. That’s why I prefer boys. They last longer.
lines.zh: 这个年纪的女孩又饥渴又迷惘，等荷尔蒙开始退潮之前，她们根本弄不清自己真正想要什么。所以我更喜欢男孩。他们更持久。

lines.en: : Take this one for example. I don’t know much about her. But, from the way she’s sitting here with her ass out and her eyes open, I’m pretty sure she’s waiting for you to hop on and take a ride.
lines.zh: 就拿这个来说吧。我对她了解不多。但看她这样撅着屁股、睁着眼睛坐在这儿，我敢肯定她在等你骑上去兜一圈。

lines.en: : So, what are you waiting for? {i}Consent?{/i} Does that really change anything at her age?
lines.zh: 那你还等什么？{i}同意？{/i}在她这个年纪，那真能改变什么吗？
如果……等等……
如果我早就……那么……为什么我……

lines.en: : If you’re trying to ask why you have to “take” something else when you’ve already “taken” something once, the answer is much simpler than you think.
lines.zh: 如果你想问的是，既然已经「拿」过一次了，为什么还得再「拿」一次别的，答案比你以为的简单得多。

lines.en: : It’s for someone else this time.
lines.zh: 这次是给别人拿的。

lines.en: : But you better hurry. Because if you wait any longer, you might not be “taking” anything at all. And it would really suck to see all of your hard work go to waste because of a {i}technicality.{/i}
lines.zh: 但你最好快点。因为再等下去，你可能什么也「拿」不到了。看着你所有的努力因为一个{i}技术性问题{/i}付诸东流，那可太惨了。

lines.en: : Also, don’t kid yourself, Aki-kun. I can tell just by looking at this girl that you’ve probably wanted her for...
lines.zh: 还有，别自欺欺人了，Aki-kun。光看这女孩，我就知道你大概想要她很久了……
很久……

lines.en: : Come to think of it, it would probably be more like {i}this.{/i} She’s tiny and you’re a {i}big{/i} boy now. I wonder how much it will hurt?
lines.zh: 这么一想，大概更像是{i}这样{/i}。她很小，而你现在是个{i}大{/i}男孩了。不知道会有多疼？
滚出去……

lines.en: : Okay! But don’t say I didn’t warn you when you chicken out and poor whatsername has to wait aeons after aeons for her beloved Aki-kun to come back.
lines.zh: 好！不过等你临阵退缩，害那位什么名字的姑娘得在无尽又无尽的岁月里等她心爱的 Aki-kun 回来的时候，可别说我没警告过你。
或者……更糟的事？
谁知道呢？

lines.en: : In the words of late, great Kurt Vonnegut Jr. — “Live by the foma that make you brave and kind and-”
lines.zh: 用已故的伟大的库尔特·冯内古特的话说——「靠着那些让你勇敢、善良、还——」的无害谎言活下去……
滚出去。

lines.en: : Wait, you didn’t let me finish my quote! “Live by the foma that-”
lines.zh: 等等，我还没引用完！「靠着那些——」
滚出去。现在。

lines.en: : Ugh. You know, you were so much nicer before my body was torn into shreds.
lines.zh: 啧。你知道吗，在我被撕成碎片之前，你可好多了。
现在。

lines.en: : {i}Fine, jeez. Guess I’ll just go back to being a stupid ghost and come see you again when you wake up on the right side of the bed. {/i}
lines.zh: {i}行吧，老天。看来我只能回去当个蠢鬼，等你哪天起床气对了再来找你。{/i}
我哥哥死之后……

lines.en: : My mom did the same thing.
lines.zh: 我妈妈也是这样。

lines.en: : She still saw him...talked to him...
lines.zh: 她还是会看见他……跟他说话……

lines.en: : But one day, that stopped. And then she wasn’t able to talk about him {i}at all.{/i}
lines.zh: 但有一天，那停了。然后她就{i}完全{/i}没法再谈起他了。

lines.en: : I still feel like she sees him sometimes. And just doesn’t tell me about it because she thinks I’ll worry.
lines.zh: 我到现在还觉得她有时能看见他。只是不告诉我，因为她觉得我会担心。
而她是对的……我会。
我{i}确实会{/i}。
但我理解。

lines.en: : And I kind of wish...I could see him too.
lines.zh: 而且我有点希望……我也能看见他。
所以……你{i}一直{/i}都醒着？
嗯。
为什么？

lines.en: : I think something is wrong with me.
lines.zh: 我觉得我有哪里不对劲。

lines.en: : No matter what I do, I keep...{i}burning up.{/i}
lines.zh: 不管我做什么，我都在……{i}燃烧{/i}。

lines.en: : Nothing makes it stop. Nothing calms it down. And most of the time, nothing even distracts me anymore.
lines.zh: 什么都没法让它停下。什么都没法让它平息。而且大多数时候，什么都没法再让我分心了。

lines.en: : I wonder if this is how she felt back then? Why she chose to be with her teacher instead of waiting for someone closer to her age.
lines.zh: 我有时会想，她当时是不是也是这种感觉？为什么会选择跟自己的老师在一起，而不是等一个年纪相仿的人。
你在说什么，Sana？
过来。
{b}再近一点。{/b}

lines.en: : A long time ago, I told you something about triangles.
lines.zh: 很久以前，我跟你说过一个关于三角形的事。

lines.en: : Do you remember what it was?
lines.zh: 你还记得是什么吗？

lines.en: : No...I can’t remember anything right now.
lines.zh: 不……我现在什么都想不起来。
我觉得我要疯了。
很好。
我不{i}想{/i}让你想起来。

lines.en: : I want you to forget everything you know about me.
lines.zh: 我想让你忘掉关于我的一切。

lines.en: : And I want to start over.
lines.zh: 我想重新开始。
我们能做到吗？
我不想。

lines.en: : Is it because you’re not attracted to me?
lines.zh: 是因为你对我没有吸引力吗？

lines.en: : It’s because I don’t {i}want{/i} to forget you. You’re important to me now.
lines.zh: 因为我不{i}想{/i}忘了你。你现在对我很重要。

lines.en: : Then let me make you feel better.
lines.zh: 那就让我让你好受一点。
让我们{i}彼此{/i}都好受一点。
把手给我。
乖孩子。
一首诗。
又来了……
停不下来……Sensei……求你……帮帮我……
再往下………啊……{i}往下……{/i}
一直………哈啊………到底……

lines.en: : Hey, sorry I took a little longer than expected.
lines.zh: 嘿，抱歉我比预想的多花了点时间。

lines.en: : Turns out Ayane has an entire convenience store in-
lines.zh: 原来 Ayane 家有一整家便利店在-
继续……
就算……她在也没关系……
什么？……
这是……
这是真的在发生吗？……
再往下……
